verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a RESTful Gmail API, including endpoints such as users.messages.send, push notifications and auth scopes. However, no item mentions official SDKs or client libraries. A raw REST API is an adjacent developer capability, not an official SDK, so it earns no credit for this story. Official SDKs are a fair axis for an email platform with a developer API, so this is "none" rather than "na".
